# Computer Science BS Core
The 2026–2027 catalog CS BS page lists MATH 111, 112, and 221; CS 170, 171, 224, 253, 255, 326, and 350; one of CS 370 or 371W; one of CS 325, 329, 334, or 377; three additional 300-level courses; and three 400-level CS courses.
# Computer Science BS Math Electives
For one of the three additional 300-level courses, the catalog permits a listed math option including MATH 315, 346, 347, 351, 361, or 362.
